summary: Session S5: Exhaustive analysis confirmed the sub-interval splitting problem is fundamental to the NF approach. Created sorry-free NFGameBridge.lean (173 lines) with helper lemmas for the NF-game bridge. Documented the complete architecture for closing the 3 remaining sorries via the EF game. The direct NF approach (strong induction, variable threading, IH threading) provably cannot work - only the game-based approach from GHR93 resolves the sub-interval problem.

blocking_issues.description: The 3 sorries (lines 2347, 2429, 2787 in StaviCompleteness.lean) require the game-based bridge. Helper lemmas are in NFGameBridge.lean. blocking_issues.root_cause: Sub-interval splitting: a type realized in interval (x,t) may appear only in sub-interval (u,t) not (x,u). The game handles this via compositional structure (ghr93_strategy_compose) which propagates types to sub-intervals automatically.
